mostWorthwhile.text: Collecting oxygen was most worthwhile because it explained its role as the lander’s oxidizer and distinguished it from fuel.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the hydrogen receiver was fairly straightforward, though it established how the plant splits water.

surprise.text: I had expected both receivers might need to be installed before electrolysis began, but hydrogen collection started with the first connection.

arbitrary.text: None felt purposeless: each receiver matched a stated collection goal, although the eventual use of the carbon dioxide was not explained.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to learn how the captured gases contribute to the early return and what the distant ice core reveals.
